title: Chapter 315 Zhang Yang'S Troubles
content:
Chapter 315 Zhang Yang'S Troubles

"Zhang Yang, what are you talking about? How is the development of your territory?" Wang Shuo didn't mind. He walked over and gave him a big bear hug.

Wang Shuo will not forget that Zhang Yang led his cavalry on a long-distance attack and came to support him when he attacked Nanshanji.

Because of this incident, Wang Shuo regarded Zhang Yang as a friend.

Zhang Yang felt that Wang Shuo was still the same Wang Shuo, and then he smiled broadly.

"Hey, there's no problem with my territory! Wang Shuo, you don't know, I finally led the troops out this time. It's really hard to explain!" Zhang Yang vomited bitterly.

Wang Shuo raised his brows and said in surprise: "Oh? What difficulties did you encounter? Don't worry, I will definitely help if I can."

After the two sat down, Zhang Yang ate a grape and continued: "You know, I said to Wang Yuyao, the person who gave me the hot water, that I would protect him for the rest of his life, so I found her later. Take her to Jiuyang Village, and then...you know."

"But now, brother, I am suffering!"

Wang Shuo rolled his eyes at him: "You already have a wife, why are you suffering?!"

"Ever since we established a relationship with her, she has been worried about this and that all day long, to the point where I don't allow any woman within ten steps of me."

Wang Shuo gave him a sympathetic look.

"This time I had to talk hard before I agreed to let me come out. Before I left, I gave you all kinds of warnings. Hey! I'm so annoyed!"

As he spoke, he showed an expression that was uglier than crying.

Wang Shuo suddenly understood that this guy was pretending to be Versailles!

At this time, the figure of Ye Xueer appeared in Wang Shuo's mind.

That kiss still reminded him of it.

Seeing Wang Shuo's expression, Zhang Yang understood it instantly as a person who had experienced it.

"Wang Shuo, do you have someone you like?"

Wang Shuo's face turned red and he quickly denied it: "What's the matter? By the way, how many people did you bring here this time and how is the equipment?"

Wang Shuo quickly changed the subject.

Speaking of this, Zhang Yang looked sad again.

"Wang Shuo, I took a look at the equipment of those guys. Compared with them, my soldiers are not at the same level at all!"

"How many people did you bring?"

"1,000 people."

Wang Shuo was also very generous and directly gave him gold equipment for 1,000 people, and also equipped each of his soldiers with a necromantic bead.

The gold equipment produced in Wang Shuo's territory can not only satisfy his own army, but there is also excess that can be traded with other lords.

After Wang Shuo received the inheritance from Changping County, it could be said that he was wealthy. 1,000 sets of gold equipment was nothing.

He even picked up 500 sets of rare equipment from the battlefield, but most of them were somewhat damaged. He is currently researching and repairing them in the blacksmith shop. He believes that it won't be long before this kind of mithril black gold armor can be mass-produced.

After the two talked about old times and complained for a while, Zhang Yang left.

Wang Shuo gathered the 60,000 troops and prepared to teleport to Shanhai City through the teleportation array.

Teleporting an army requires a lot of time and must be arranged in advance.

After the arrangements were made, Wang Shuo took Gong Zheng and Ye Tianba and teleported there first.

At this time, the teleportation array in Haihe City has been put under military control.

As soon as Wang Shuo came out, an officer was in charge of receiving him.

"Your Excellency is Changping County Magistrate Wang Shuo, County Magistrate Wang!"

A senior officer came over and asked in a very friendly manner.

"Yes, that's right."

"The county governor has an order. After the county magistrate Wang arrives, please go to the county governor's mansion immediately to discuss matters."

Wang Shuo was shocked before he could speak.

There were lords shouting around.

"Hey, I've been here for so long, but I'm not qualified to enter the county governor's house. He's not a big deal. He was summoned by the county governor as soon as he came."

"Yes, look at my eldest brother. He has a majestic appearance, a majestic weapon, and the appearance of a great emperor. County Sheriff Zhao should summon him immediately."
